Boundary covers our single Bangalore office (Scope 2) and our outsourced cloud infrastructure (Scope 3 Category 1 and 11).

ElevenLabs is committed to minimizing the carbon footprint of our AI models. Our direct emissions (Scope 1 and 2) are extremely low as we operate entirely out of a single leased office. Our primary emissions are Scope 3, specifically from cloud computing (AWS and GCP) used for training and running inference for our Text-to-Speech (TTS) models. We actively prioritize cloud regions powered by renewable energy and optimize our GPU compute utilization.

Effectiveness is tracked via cloud provider carbon dashboards and API inference efficiency metrics (compute per 1M characters). The engineering team reviews compute intensity monthly to optimize model efficiency and reduce associated energy use.

Implemented model compression and knowledge distillation, reducing the GPU memory and compute required per inference request by 30%. Migrated 40% of non-latency-sensitive batch processing workloads to cloud regions with high renewable energy mix.
Internal engineering benchmarks for compute intensity.
